originals.prompt: Create a photorealistic synthetic insurance training photo contact sheet. EXACTLY SIX square photographs in a precise edge-to-edge grid of 3 columns and 2 rows, equally sized, straight dividing boundaries, no margins, no titles, no labels, no text overlays. Each panel must be a separate photograph of THE EXACT SAME individual vehicle, same damage, same alloy wheels, same body color, same trim and windows, in the same plain outdoor inspection yard with soft overcast daylight. Entire car clearly in frame in each wide view with generous space around bumpers. Camera at standing height, natural smartphone inspection photography, deep focus, neutral color. Physical vehicle sides must remain consistent as camera moves. Panel order reading left to right: top row = front-left three-quarter wide, front-right three-quarter wide, rear-left three-quarter wide; bottom row = rear-right three-quarter wide, damage close-up, second damage close-up. All six show the same stationary car from different real camera angles. Generic blank registration plate. Subject: a silver 2021 BMW 330i G20 sedan with five-spoke silver wheels and dark interior. Moderate localized front-left impact: front-left bumper cover cracked and displaced, left front fender creased above the wheel arch, left headlamp outer lens cracked. Hood, wheels, glass, doors, rear and right side remain intact and straight. Panel 5 close-up shows front-left bumper crack and broken lamp. Panel 6 close-up shows left fender crease. Damage is localized cosmetic bolt-on components, not catastrophic.
